integrity: Analytic all-parameter proof and standalone exact finite checker included. No independent mathematical validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: All dimensions are at least two; only complete-bipartite partial matching polytopes in the unscaled Frobenius metric are covered.
Finite modular face-rank tests supplement a constructive proof and are not universal verification.
Square-matrix face-lattice literature can cover some incidence conclusions; the entire Cao--Chen full text was not available, so priority of the metric classification is provisional.
title: Sharp dual two-neighborliness and angular mean reversal for rectangular matching polytopes
